name: Camo | Natural Leaf Wraps | Strawberry Yuzu Matcha
description: Camo x Pod Juice Natural Leaf Wraps are made from chamomile and matcha plants, these are totally different than any other wrap you carry! This is a limited-edition collaboration collection called the Matcha Edition. These slow-burning, self-rolling wraps pair perfectly with herbal blends. 5 wraps come in each resealable foil pack.
